title: Dolphin with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='body' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#8fd6ff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#3f9fe0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='belly' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#eaf8ff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#bfe6f7'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- tail fluke -->
  <path d='M14 40 Q6 24 18 20 Q22 34 30 42 Z' fill='#3f9fe0'/>
  <path d='M14 44 Q4 58 18 62 Q24 48 32 44 Z' fill='#5cb4ea'/>

  <path d='M28 42 Q34 18 56 18 Q80 20 88 40 Q92 54 78 62 Q58 72 40 64 Q26 56 28 42 Z' fill='url(#body)'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <path d='M40 62 Q60 70 78 61 Q70 55 56 56 Q46 57 40 62 Z' fill='url(#belly)'/>

  <path d='M48 20 Q54 6 66 14 Q60 18 60 22 Z' fill='#2f8fd4'/>

  <path d='M48 54 Q44 66 56 70 Q56 60 58 56 Z' fill='#5cb4ea'/>

  <path d='M84 38 Q96 40 95 46 Q90 50 82 48 Z' fill='#b5e8ff'/>

  <!-- sparkle stars around eye -->
  <path d='M62 26 l1.4 3 3 1.4 -3 1.4 -1.4 3 -1.4 -3 -3 -1.4 3 -1.4 Z' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M84 28 l1 2.2 2.2 1 -2.2 1 -1 2.2 -1 -2.2 -2.2 -1 2.2 -1 Z' fill='#e8fbff'/>
  <!-- smile sparkle on beak -->
  <path d='M90 50 l0.8 1.7 1.7 0.8 -1.7 0.8 -0.8 1.7 -0.8 -1.7 -1.7 -0.8 1.7 -0.8 Z' fill='#ffffff'/>
